provenance.unit_costs: REAL — published central scheme norms, adapters/in/schemes.yaml
provenance.scheme_eligibility: A scheme is proposed only where its published settlement scope overlaps what the sector indicator measures. The roads indicator counts villages only, so no urban roads scheme is proposed anywhere in this build.
provenance.beneficiaries_per_unit: Published norms (IPHS catchment, RTE class size, Census household size), capped at the deprived population
provenance.deficit: REAL — NFHS-5 2019-21 (IIPS/MoHFW), reconciled onto this boundary set. See docs/DATA-RECONCILIATION.md
provenance.population: Census 2011 via Wikidata (CC0), where reconciled; null otherwise
provenance.distinct_submitters: LOWER BOUND — post-dedup cluster count, not a counted headcount
provenance.reused_images: NOT MEASURED in the synthetic corpus — reported as zero, never estimated
provenance.burst_share: NOT MEASURED — the aggregated fixture carries no per-report timestamps

summary.optimality_note: Density-ordered greedy with equity and spread repair. Near-optimal, not proven optimal — the gap is typically a few percent on instances of this shape, and every inclusion and exclusion is individually traceable.

constraints.name: equity_floor
constraints.detail: 3872697000 reaches deprived units against a floor of 1176667500.

constraints.name: geographic_spread
constraints.detail: 25 groups covered against a minimum of 8.

constraints.name: sector_cap
constraints.detail: No sector exceeds 40% of the envelope.

constraints.name: outreach_reserve
constraints.detail: 60900000 reserved for outreach into units that never reported, 16875000 for field verification.
